chapter: Army and arrival in New Orleans
title: Playing second trumpet with Celestin's orchestra
summary: He played with Celestin as second trumpet and some featured trumpet around 1922, though Jack Carey was his main man.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: No. A lot of people don't know I played with Celestan but I did, I played with Celestan, Goodwild. But Jack Kerr was my main man you know.
What did you play, second trumpet with Celestan?
Was that a brass band job or?
Well I played in a brass band on a parade but I played, I'm talking about his dance orchestra now. I did some of the feature trumpet for him.
I'd say in 22. Right in there.
And who was his second trumpet before you?
Oh, let me see who he is. At least no shots come after me. That was an old man, I forget who it was now. But shots come after me you know. Didn't I think I killed after shots eh?

Either him or Ricard, I can't remember which. They were both in there and I can never remember which is which. So let's see, you were in the army and who were some of the other New Orleans guys in the army with you?
